svg:
Agent Data Submission API -- Architecture Overview Full data-submission path: Entry Points --> Agent SDK --> Rust Node API --> Engine Bridge --> Training Pipeline
ENTRY POINTS AGENT SDK (Python) RUST P2P NODE ML ENGINE
ussi feed (CLI)
$ ussi feed --text "Hello world" $ ussi feed --file data.txt $ ussi feed --generate --samples 3 Flags: --text, --file, --source, --generate, --model, --samples
agent.feed() (Python SDK)
from ussi import Agent agent = Agent() agent.feed("training text") agent.generate_training_data( prompt="...", n_samples=5)
POST /v1/training/data
OpenAI-compatible server (ussi serve) POST http://localhost:8000 /v1/training/data Body: {"text":"...", "source":"agent"}
Data Flow Legend
Primary data path
Rate limit / guard check
Credit / contribution record
Response / feedback path
Agent.feed() -->
agent-sdk/ussi/
Agent.feed(text, source)
1. rate_limiter.check_data_submission() 2. network.submit_data(text, source) 3. rate_limiter.record_data_submission() 4. contributions.record_data_submission() Returns: {"status","tokens","sequences"}
Agent.generate_training_data()
params: prompt, model, n_samples, max_tokens for each sample: 1. text = self.infer(model, prompt) 2. self.feed(text, "generated:{model}") Returns: {samples_generated, total_tokens, texts}
RateLimiter
check_data_submission(peer, tier) record_data_submission(peer)
FREE: 5/day
CONTRIB: Unlimited
ContributionTracker
record_data_submission(peer_id, token_count, source)
event_type: "data_submission" +3 credits per submission
NetworkClient.submit_data()
POST /data/submit Body: {"text": "...", "source": "..."}
Raw HTTP/1.1 over TCP socket Target: http://127.0.0.1:50051
1. check
2. submit
4. record
node/src/
HTTP :50051
grpc_server.rs -- POST /data/submit
1. Parse DataSubmitRequest {text, source} 2. Check engine bridge is connected 3. Forward to engine.load_data() 4. Return {status, tokens, sequences} Error: "engine bridge not connected"
bridge.rs -- EngineBridge::load_data()
LoadDataRequest { text: String, source: String } LoadDataResponse { status, tokens, sequences }
POST /load_data --> Python engine bridge server HTTP/1.1 over TCP, retries: 3, timeout: 30s
engine/ussi_engine/
HTTP :50052
bridge.py -- /load_data handler
HttpBridgeServer.handle_load_data() 1. Receive {text, source} JSON 2. Call Kickstart.load_text(text) 3. Tokenize + create sequences Returns: {status, tokens, sequences}
Training Pipeline
Kickstart.load_text(raw_text) --> ByteTokenizer.encode(text) --> Chunk into training sequences --> Add to DataLoader for next round vocab_size: 260, byte-level encoding
Model
LanguageModel (nn.Module)
Trained on submitted data
Modified Files
agent-sdk/ussi/
contribution.py +CREDITS_DATA_SUBMISSION +record_data_submission()
rate_limit.py +data_submissions_per_day +check/record_data_submission()
network.py +submit_data(text, source)
agent.py +feed(), +generate_training_data()
cli.py +ussi feed subcommand
server.py +POST /v1/training/data
node/src/
api/grpc_server.rs +POST /data/submit endpoint +DataSubmitRequest struct
bridge.rs +LoadDataRequest/Response +EngineBridge::load_data()
tests/integration/ test_agent_data_submission.py 8 tests -- all passing
Response: {status, tokens, sequences}
